Hi Vivek / Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. We were impressed with Redwood's latency profile and the autoscaling options; next step from our side is to formalize a mutual action plan so legal/procurement and our security team can run in parallel. Two asks to start:

2) Who will be our Redwood point-of-contact for SOC 2 evidence requests and for data handling questions (encryption at rest, key management, log retention)? Our security team wants named owners so they know who to query.

Scope suggestions:

Evidence ownership (initial assignments):
- SOC 2 control owner & evidence collection lead: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) — runbook and checklist owner
- Data handling / encryption at rest & KMS flow: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com) — will provide architecture diagrams and KMS key lifecycle docs
- Access control & logging evidence: Alex Martinez will coordinate with engineering to surface audit logs on request

Deliverables we will prepare for the MAP kickoff:
- Evidence inventory (SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx) with sample file naming conventions and redaction guidance
- Short runbook on how to request evidence and expected SLAs for delivery
- A one-pager on data retention and key-management (summary level)

Notes on timelines: we can aim for the 2-week evidence collection window if Orion can commit to a single point of contact on your side for follow-up questions (so we dont run into back-and-forth delays).

If you agree, Ill join the kickoff and bring the evidence inventory and runbook.
